material.title: Updated Plans for Thursday’s Visit
material.passage:
Subject: Thursday’s Visit to Harbor Office

Dear Maya,

I have updated the schedule for your visit on Thursday. Your appointment with our design team will begin at 10:30 a.m., thirty minutes later than originally planned. This change will give you extra time to travel from the station.

Meeting Room B is available that morning, and it can accommodate all eight visitors. It also has a large screen for your presentation. I have made a lunch reservation at the café across the street for 12:30 p.m. The café offers vegetarian meals, so everyone in your group should find something suitable.

Please confirm the number of visitors by Tuesday afternoon. If arriving at the station at 9:45 a.m. is convenient for you, I will arrange for our driver to meet you there. Otherwise, please suggest another arrival time. The office tour will follow lunch and finish by 3:00 p.m.

Best regards,
Daniel
material.translation:
主旨：週四造訪港灣辦公室

親愛的 Maya：

我已更新您週四來訪的行程。您與我們設計團隊的預約會面將於上午十點半開始，比原訂時間晚三十分鐘。這項調整會讓您有更多時間從車站前往辦公室。

當天上午會議室 B 可供使用，而且能容納全部八位訪客。會議室也有供您簡報使用的大螢幕。我已在街道對面的咖啡館預訂中午十二點半的午餐。咖啡館提供素食餐點，因此您的團隊中每個人應該都能找到合適的餐點。

請於週二下午之前確認訪客人數。如果上午九點四十五分抵達車站對您而言方便，我會安排我們的司機到那裡接您。否則，請提出其他抵達時間。辦公室導覽將在午餐後進行，並於下午三點之前結束。

祝好，
Daniel

questions.prompt: Why was the appointment moved to a later time?
options: To allow more time for lunch
To give Maya more time to travel from the station
To let the driver finish the office tour
To allow the team to prepare vegetarian meals
questions.explanation: 信中明確說明，延後會面是為了讓 Maya 有更多時間從車站前往辦公室。
questions.evidence: This change will give you extra time to travel from the station.
optionExplanations: 文中沒有說調整會面時間是為了延長午餐時間。
這與信中所述的調整原因完全一致。
文中沒有提到司機會參與或完成辦公室導覽。
素食餐點由咖啡館提供，並非團隊需要準備，也不是延後會面的原因。

questions.prompt: What does “accommodate” mean in the description of Meeting Room B?
options: Provide enough space for the visitors
questions.explanation: 此處主詞是會議室，accommodate 表示空間足以容納全部八位訪客。
questions.evidence: Meeting Room B is available that morning, and it can accommodate all eight visitors.
optionExplanations: 會議室的功能不是運送訪客；接送安排在信中另有說明。
這句話談的是會議室容量，沒有挑選訪客的意思。
這句話沒有描述聯絡訪客的行動。
這正是此處 accommodate 的意思：提供足夠空間容納訪客。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct completion: “If arriving at the station at 9:45 a.m. ___ convenient for you, I will arrange for our driver to meet you there.”
questions.explanation: 動名詞片語 arriving at the station at 9:45 a.m. 作為主詞時視為單數，因此應搭配現在式單數動詞 is。
questions.evidence: If arriving at the station at 9:45 a.m. is convenient for you, I will arrange for our driver to meet you there.
optionExplanations: is 是單數現在式動詞，能與作為單數主詞的動名詞片語搭配。
are 用於複數主詞等情況，不符合此處的單數動名詞片語主詞。
be 是原形，此處沒有助動詞或其他可使其使用原形的結構。
being 是分詞形式，無法單獨充當此 if 子句所需的限定動詞。

questions.prompt: What does Daniel ask Maya to do by Tuesday afternoon?
options: Confirm how many visitors will attend
questions.explanation: Daniel 要求 Maya 在週二下午之前確認訪客人數。
questions.evidence: Please confirm the number of visitors by Tuesday afternoon.
optionExplanations: 信中提到簡報用的大螢幕，但沒有要求週二前寄送簡報。
信中提到咖啡館提供素食，沒有要求提前選餐。
這正是信中明確提出且附有週二下午期限的要求。
辦公室導覽安排在週四午餐後，不是週二前要完成的事項。
